meta.themes: Cloud Model Choice Expands, AI Investment Reshapes Work, AI Factories Mature, Agent Governance Moves Into Production

news.title: OpenAI models arrived on Google Cloud
news.summary: Google Cloud added GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna to its model garden, with marketplace billing and Codex workflow connections for enterprise customers.

news.title: Google Cloud added an Anthropic-managed Claude option
news.summary: Google Cloud launched an Anthropic-managed Claude deployment with day-zero model access, managed agents, skills, and code execution alongside its Google-managed option.

news.title: Anthropic previewed Claude Duet as a proactive agent
news.summary: Anthropic opened a waitlisted Claude Duet preview that monitors connected apps, prepares daily briefs, completes delegated work, and requests approval before acting.

news.title: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio
news.summary: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio to combine its drug-development coordination platform with Rosalind models and tools for life-sciences research workflows.

news.title: Anthropic committed equity to a public benefit fund
news.summary: Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a new public benefit fund, with a mechanism that can add equity as the company's value increases.

news.title: Barclays tied 5,000 planned job cuts to AI efficiency
news.summary: Barclays said it plans to cut about 5% of its workforce as organizational simplification and AI-driven technology efficiency reshape support functions.

news.title: NVIDIA launched Minerva for AI factory observability
news.summary: NVIDIA launched Minerva, an AIOps platform that unifies infrastructure and workload telemetry to detect failures and improve GPU uptime across AI factories.

news.title: HPE and NVIDIA expanded secure agentic AI infrastructure
news.summary: HPE expanded its NVIDIA-backed AI Factory portfolio with governed MCP services, mixed-GPU clusters, Vera CPU racks, and secure agent runtime support.

news.title: Australia updated its responsible AI policy for government
news.summary: Australia updated the policy requiring federal agencies to assign accountable officials, publish transparency statements, maintain use-case registers, and assess AI impacts.

news.title: Google opened Agents CLI to multiple frameworks
news.summary: Google's Agents CLI extension system now supports alternate frameworks and custom governance commands, including a first-party LangChain extension with pinned Git revisions.

news.title: Amazon Bedrock added structured outputs for Claude
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock added schema-constrained JSON and strict tool inputs for Claude models, reducing custom parsing and retry logic in production automations.

news.title: Microsoft framed enterprise agents as security insiders
news.summary: Microsoft proposed continuous identity, permission, data, network, and runtime controls for enterprise agents, supervised by risk-aware guardian agents.
